rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; on the reply format, not the tax reading. The prompt (.classm/classm.eic.1.prompt.txt) lists the line as "line (Step 5, 1)" and says each line is "named by its printed number as it appears in the IRS text (where two lines share a number, followed by a name in parentheses: answer with the whole handle, exactly as given)"; the reply names it "Step 5, 1" without the parentheses, the class M parser (tools/transcription/classm.py extract) strips only a leading 'line ' before matching, and the log records no answer (the replies for classm.eic.3 to classm.eic.8 use "(Step 5, 1)" and were read). The reply's value is $5,137.00 (Form 1040 line 1z); the project's is $5,137.00. They are equal, and Step 5 is reached on this return (eic.reached_step5 true; Worksheet A line 1 $5,137.00 agrees), so no project defect. No expectation is recorded for a line without a parsed answer; nothing to drop.

Ruling: representation; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. Ruling: representation; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. Worksheet B is used only when Step 5, question 2 is Yes (i1040gi p. 42, 'Were you self-employed at any time in 2025'); the project figures its lines for every return and line 1 of Worksheet A reads them only for a return with a Schedule C (eic.self_employed), so the credit is the same.

Ruling: representation; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. Where the printed steps say STOP (Steps 1 to 5) or line 4 is Yes (line 5 skipped) or line 2 is zero, the model leaves the later Worksheet A lines blank; the project computes every line regardless and applies eligibility in eic.credit, which Form 1040 line 27a reads (zero when a step stops). In an ordinary evaluation the worksheet lines are not reached on an ineligible return; where the model fills line 6 it agrees with the project, and where a step stops (for example Form 2555 at Step 1, question 3) the project's line 6 is figured but Form 1040 line 27a is zero or refused.

Ruling: model error; on the reply format, not the tax reading. The prompt (.classm/classm.eic.2.prompt.txt) lists the line as "line (Step 5, 1)" and says each line is "named by its printed number as it appears in the IRS text (where two lines share a number, followed by a name in parentheses: answer with the whole handle, exactly as given)"; the reply names it "Step 5, 1" without the parentheses, the class M parser (tools/transcription/classm.py extract) strips only a leading 'line ' before matching, and the log records no answer (the replies for classm.eic.3 to classm.eic.8 use "(Step 5, 1)" and were read). The reply's value is blank ("Step 1 Q1: MFS, no children with valid SSNs, AGI $22,732 is not under $19,104, so STOP and Step 5 is never reached"); the project's is $0.00. The reply's blank is right: i1040gi p. 40, Step 1, question 1, "No children who have valid SSNs lived with you, is the amount on Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11b, less than $19,104 ...? No. STOP" (eic.reached_step5 false). The project's Step 5 lines are helpers that shown_when cannot hide (TASKS T-067), but every one is $0.00 here, which the skipped-line rule permits; no finding. Nothing to drop.
